Omar (AE): Folks — new POC with NorthPoint. They requested 6x A100 dedicated in europe-west3-a (strict). Provision job id p-resv-332. Console shows 'AZ_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED'. Can we triage?
Sana (SE): On it. Can you paste the exact error? Also did they request committed pricing and a security questionnaire?
Omar (AE): Error: "ReservationFailed: AZ_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED requested=[europe-west3-a] available={europe-west3-a:0,europe-west3-b:4,europe-west3-c:3}" They want committed price for 6 GPUs and sent SOC2/HIPAA qs.
Tomas (Infra): Cluster view: region has 7 free GPUs but not concentrated in 'a'. For strict single-AZ=6 we can't satisfy. Options: (1) Offer preference (soft) affinity with failover to b, (2) move to europe-west2 where capacity exists, (3) reduce to 3-4 GPUs in a.
Karina (CS): On security: Dedicated supports VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and detailed audit logs. For HIPAA we need a signed BAA; legal can start once they confirm POC scope.
Sana (SE): Pricing: committed per-GPU applies regardless of AZ layout. No multi-AZ surcharge. We'll include a 30-day review clause. Suggest default: preference_affinity to europe-west3-a with failover to b.
Omar (AE): Customer prefers not to move region. They asked: if we accept preference_affinity, can we ensure their data stays in europe-west3?
Tomas (Infra): Yes — all resources remain in europe-west3 region; preference_affinity only allows spill to other AZs within same region. We can produce audit logs showing exact AZ placement for first 72h.
Sana (SE): I'll draft the short email: explain the allocation issue, propose soft-affinity + audit access + committed quote.
allocator-bot: reprovision queued p-resv-332 --affinity=preferred --failover=europe-west3-b
allocator-bot: AllocationComplete alloc-331 status=PARTIAL_PREFERRED placed=2@europe-west3-a,4@europe-west3-b
Omar (AE): Customer accepted soft-affinity and requested the committed invoice + 72h audit read access. Karina, can you action the audit grant?
Karina (CS): Created grant id=grant-np-77 for 72h read-only audit access. Sent to Omar. I'll loop legal for the BAA.
Tomas (Infra): Note for records: if they later need strict 6x in single AZ we'll need cloud provider reservation lead time or alternative region.
Omar (AE): POC unblocked. Thanks team! :tada:
